changelog: Fix: live SUM(fees) for challenge 6 was 138.0490 against the expected 138.1159 -- a 0.0669 gap. Cause: trade 80 (BNBUSDT, manually logged) carried a hand-typed time_in of 2026-09-14 06:08:00 against Bitfunded's own 06:08:19, so 2026_09_17_0005's fee UPDATE (matched on challenge_id/pair/direction/time_in, same as every other row) silently matched zero rows for it -- its fee stayed at the hand-entered 3.80 instead of 3.8669. All other 58 rows matched the CSV exactly

Fix: 2026_09_17_0005 now corrects trade 80's time_in/time_out to Bitfunded's own values before the fee UPDATEs run, rather than special-casing that one UPDATE's WHERE clause -- once corrected, the existing match key finds it like every other row. A pre-flight guard condition asserts trade 80's known-stale state before the fix runs, matching the pattern already used for the rest of the file

Post-flight targets unchanged from v3.13.2: fees 138.1159, net_pnl -258.1959, pnl -120.08, 59 trades, trade_variables 135 -- this was always what they should have been; the gap was in whether the fee UPDATEs could find every row, not in what values they'd apply once they did

This is the fourth off-by-seconds hand-typed timestamp to cause a silent problem on this account (trade 59's date/time_in, trade 77's stuck Open status, the ZEC duplicate, now this) -- documented in CLAUDE.md as a pattern: every one was a silent miss (zero rows matched or an extra row inserted), not a loud error. Trade 80 is now the last row in challenge 6 known to have carried a hand-typed timestamp discrepancy
